A match blocks the rule, even if the window is in the allowed list.

An application is matched by its ID or process name: the whole name, ignoring case, with * and ? as wildcards. A window title item matches when the title contains the text. Any matching item is enough. An empty list imposes no restrictions.
No restrictions: the rule works in every window.

Any match allows the rule. An empty list allows all windows.
